lines.en: label beachwars13:
: Ladies and gentlemen!
lines.zh: : 女士们先生们!

lines.en: : And anyone with an identity that either of the aforementioned titles do not properly describe!
lines.zh: : 还有任何觉得上述两个称谓都无法准确描述自己身份的人!

lines.en: scene beachcookoff1
: With two contests already underway and four others finished, the time has come for the hotly anticipated Sunday Dorm Wars Marathon!
lines.zh: : 两场比赛正在进行,另外四场已经结束,现在是万众瞩目的周日宿舍战争马拉松的时间了!

lines.en: : That’s right, people! And we’ve got a hell of a lineup for you beginning in just a few moments!
lines.zh: : 没错,各位!再过几分钟,我们就有一份超豪华的节目单奉上!

lines.en: scene beachcookoff2
: Miss Imai, when I say the word “beach,” what is the first thing that comes to mind?
lines.zh: : Imai 老师,当我说出『海滩』这个词,你最先想到的是什么?

lines.en: : Sharks!
lines.zh: : 鲨鱼!

lines.en: : Try again!
lines.zh: : 再猜一次!

lines.en: : Scuba-diving!
lines.zh: : 潜水!

lines.en: : Try one more time, but think of something we already have a contest lined up for today!
lines.zh: : 再猜最后一次,不过要想想我们今天已经安排好的比赛项目!

lines.en: : Food!
lines.zh: : 食物!

lines.en: scene beachcookoff3
: Bingo! Which means our first contest of the day pits former best friends, Molly MacCormack and Rin Rokuhara, up against one another in an area {i}no one{/i} could have ever expected!
lines.zh: : 答对了!也就是说,我们今天的第一场比赛,将由曾经的挚友 Molly MacCormack 和 Rin Rokuhara,在一个{i}谁都{/i}意想不到的领域展开对决!

lines.en: : Will Rin be able to recover after being flashed by her bandmate? Has Molly figured out how to tone down her ADHD long enough to receive cooking advice from Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : Rin 在被乐队同伴露体之后,能恢复过来吗?Molly 能不能压住自己的多动症,好好听完 Tsuneyo 的烹饪指导?

lines.en: : All these questions and more will be answered shortly!
lines.zh: : 所有这些问题,马上就会有答案!

lines.en: scene beachcookoff4
: But before that, here’s a quick preview of everything {i}else{/i} on the docket for today! Take it away, Imani!
lines.zh: : 但在此之前,先快速预览一下今天{i}剩下的{/i}全部项目!交给你了,Imani!

lines.en: : After what is sure to be the {i}worst{/i} cookoff mankind has ever seen, we’ll be coming at you with a very special showdown between two {i}more{/i} bandmates, Otoha Okakura and Sana Sakakibara!
lines.zh: : 在这场人类有史以来{i}最惨烈{/i}的厨艺对决之后,我们将为您带来另{i}两位{/i}乐队同伴之间的特别对决:Otoha Okakura 对 Sana Sakakibara!

lines.en: : However! We have decided that, in the spirit of the no-longer-existing date war, to not televise either of these confessions as things like that are best done in private!
lines.zh: : 不过!我们决定,本着那场已经不复存在的约会战争的精神,这两场告白都不会直播,因为这种事还是私下里做最好!

lines.en: : Especially with a roster of girls so wet that you’d be able to tell we’re at the beach even {i}without{/i} the giant ocean behind us!
lines.zh: : 尤其是,参赛的姑娘们湿成这样,就算背后{i}没有{/i}那片巨大的海洋,你也能看出我们在海滩上!

lines.en: scene beachcookoff5
: I don’t think you’re allowed to say that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这话你不该说。

lines.en: : I’m not! I just don’t get to hold the mic very often and got caught up in the moment.
lines.zh: : 我知道不该!我只是很少有机会拿麦克风,一激动就说了。

lines.en: scene beachcookoff1
: Ignoring what Imani just said and how correct she was in doing so, we’ll be moving right along after the confession battle to what might just be the most competitive contest of all!
lines.zh: : 无视 Imani 刚才说的话,以及她说得有多正确,告白大战之后,我们马上进入可能是全场最激烈的一场比赛!

lines.en: : That’s right, folks! Ami Arakawa, Sensei’s dedicated and loving niece-slash-caretaker takes on Touka Tsukioka — {i}Yasu’s{/i} loving {i}friend{/i}-slash-caretaker!
lines.zh: : 没错,各位!Ami Arakawa——Sensei 忠诚又体贴的侄女兼看护人,对战 Touka Tsukioka——{i}Yasu{/i} 亲爱的{i}朋友{/i}兼看护人!

lines.en: : Two girls with two hearts of gold and one man with a heart made of muscle and blood and stuff! Which one of them would Sensei rather wake up to every morning?! And why is it Ami?!
lines.zh: : 两个女孩,两颗金子般的心,而那个男人的心是由肌肉和血液之类的东西做的!Sensei 更希望每天早上在谁身边醒来?!为什么答案是 Ami?!

lines.en: : But that’s not all! We’ve got {i}one more{/i} competition to wrap this trip up with, and it’s a dramatic faceoff between two childhood friends, Futaba Fukuyama and Nodoka Nagasawa!
lines.zh: : 但这还没完!我们还有{i}最后一场{/i}比赛来收尾,那是两位青梅竹马之间的戏剧性对决:Futaba Fukuyama 对 Nodoka Nagasawa!

lines.en: scene beachcookoff6
: Any thoughts going into that last competition, Imani? Early polls have Nodoka winning by a landslide.
lines.zh: : 对最后那场比赛有什么看法,Imani?早期民调显示 Nodoka 会以压倒性优势获胜。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t be so sure, Uta. Rumor has it that Nodoka might be planning on throwing the competition — citing a “lack of inspiration” as the purpose behind her deciding to pull out.
lines.zh: : 我可没那么确定,Uta。有传闻说 Nodoka 可能打算放水——理由是『缺乏灵感』,所以她决定退出。

lines.en: : I personally wouldn’t trust {i}any{/i} rumor involving Nodoka and “pulling out.”
lines.zh: : 我个人不会相信{i}任何{/i}同时涉及 Nodoka 和『退出』的传闻。

lines.en: : I don’t think you’re allowed to say that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这话你不该说。

lines.en: scene beachcookoff1
: You’re probably right! Which means that {i}both{/i} of us should take a few minutes to review the terms our network has laid out for us before our next televised event!
lines.zh: : 你大概是对的!那么在下一场直播之前,{i}我们两个{/i}该花几分钟复习一下电视台给我们定下的用语规范!

lines.en: : But don’t touch that dial just yet! Because it seems like the cooking war is about to kick off!
lines.zh: : 但先别换台!因为厨艺大战似乎就要开始了!

lines.en: : Now, let’s head on over to our contestants and see how they’re doing!
lines.zh: : 现在,让我们把镜头转向参赛者,看看她们进展如何!

lines.en: scene beachcookoff7
: Ohhhh man. Okay. Time to stop thinking about boobs and get my head back into the game.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦天哪。好了。别再想胸部了,把心思放回比赛上。

lines.en: : Why are there...so many different...spices?...Are we...are we...supposed to use them all?...
lines.zh: : 为什么有……这么多种不同的……香料?……我们……我们是不是……该全部都用上?……

lines.en: scene beachcookoff8
: Sana, as my carefully selected sous chef, this is something you should know. The answer is yes.
lines.zh: : Sana,作为我精心挑选的副厨,这种事你该知道。答案是:是的。

lines.en: : I...don’t even understand...why you picked me in the first place, when...Futaba is...way better at cooking than I am...
lines.zh: : 我……甚至不明白……你为什么一开始就选我……明明 Futaba 做饭……比我强太多了……

lines.en: : Futaba has a contest to prepare for.  Plus, she was very adamant about me learning to take care of myself for some reason.
lines.zh: : Futaba 有比赛要准备。而且她不知为什么,非常坚持要我学会照顾自己。

lines.en: : I...I think we might...have to learn that together, since...I’ve never even...used a knife before...
lines.zh: : 我……我觉得我们可能……得一起学,因为……我连……刀都没用过……

lines.en: : Uh-oh! It looks like Rin has chosen an inexperienced partner as her sous chef for the cooking competition!
lines.zh: : 哦豁!看起来 Rin 为这场厨艺比赛选了一位毫无经验的副厨!

lines.en: : What an intense handicap, Uta! Now there are {i}three{/i} clueless cooks in the kitchen! And you know what they say about having too many cooks!
lines.zh: : 好大的劣势啊,Uta!现在厨房里有{i}三个{/i}一窍不通的厨子了!你们知道关于厨子太多那句话怎么说吧!

lines.en: : They spoil the broth!
lines.zh: : 会搅坏一锅汤!

lines.en: : No! They say that productivity slumps and that somebody is going to have to be sent home early so the business can make money!
lines.zh: : 不对!那句话是说:生产效率会下降,而且总得有人提前被送回家,好让公司赚钱!

lines.en: scene beachcookoff9
: I...volunteer to...go home...
lines.zh: : 我……自愿……回家……

lines.en: : Don’t listen to her. I need all the help I can get. Molly has Tsuneyo and that’s already an unfair advantage.
lines.zh: : 别听她的。我需要所有能得到的帮助。Molly 有 Tsuneyo,那已经是天大的优势了。

lines.en: : Or is it?! Because it seems as if there is already a bit of turmoil in the opposing kitchen!
lines.zh: : 是吗?!因为对手的厨房里似乎已经有点乱套了!

lines.en: : Let’s head on over and check it out!
lines.zh: : 我们去看看!

lines.en: scene beachcookoff10
: What do you {i}mean{/i} you did not refer to the numerous guides I provided you? I even took it upon myself to craft them in a manner you would be sure to understand.
lines.zh: : 你说你没参考我给你的那么多指南是什么{i}意思{/i}?我甚至还特意,用你一定能看懂的方式把它们写了出来。

lines.en: : Kendo Princess, I appreciate you labeling your cookbook as a quest log, but you must understand that there are certain things I will simply never be able to grasp!
lines.zh: : 剑道公主,我很感谢你把食谱标成任务日志,但你必须明白,有些东西我是永远搞不懂的!

lines.en: : Like the handle of this dagger as I do not have the required proficiency to wield it!
lines.zh: : 比如这把匕首的握柄,因为我没有使用它所要求的熟练度!

lines.en: : Emerald Guardian, your lack of preparation is not only bewildering, but offensive to me as I have done all I can to help you.
lines.zh: : 翡翠守护者,你毫无准备这件事不仅令人费解,而且是在侮辱我,因为我已经尽全力在帮你了。

lines.en: : It’s fine! {i}I’m{/i} fine! Rin has no idea what we’re doing either! And with you in my party, I can focus purely on channeling the elements to ensure our food is cooked!
lines.zh: : 没事!{i}我{/i}很好!Rin 也不知道我们在干什么!而且有你在我的队伍里,我可以专心引导元素,确保我们的食物被做熟!

lines.en: : You expect me to win this contest {i}for{/i} you?
lines.zh: : 你指望我{i}替你{/i}赢下这场比赛?

lines.en: scene beachcookoff11
: Isn’t that the sous chef’s job?! To do all of the hard work while the head chef sits back and takes credit for all of it?!
lines.zh: : 那不就是副厨的工作吗?!干所有苦力活,而主厨靠在后面把功劳全揽走?!

lines.en: : I am hesitant to help you {i}at all{/i} at this point as you have rejected both my kindness and skills in my efforts to instruct you.
lines.zh: : 事到如今,我都有点{i}不想帮你{/i}了,因为你拒绝了我的善意,也拒绝了我教导你的技能。

lines.en: : You can’t just aggro the trash and then quit the group, Kendo Princess! You’re gonna wipe the party!
lines.zh: : 你不能拉了怪就退队啊,剑道公主!你会害全队团灭的!

lines.en: : I am not yet fluent in “geek speak,” but to that I will say — the DPS is too low, the healer sucks, and the tank has been AFK for ten minutes. I am reporting all of you for gameplay sabotage.
lines.zh: : 我还不太会说『宅话』,但对此我要说——DPS 太低,治疗是废物,坦克已经 AFK 十分钟了。我要把你们全部举报,理由是蓄意破坏游戏。

lines.en: scene black
: We could have just voted to kick the tank! You didn’t have to kill the whole group!
lines.zh: : 我们本来可以投票把坦克踢了!你没必要害死全队!

lines.en: scene beachcookoff12
: Holy cannoli, Friendburger. Things are sure getting cray-cray over here in wet sand world.
lines.zh: : 我的天哪,朋友汉堡。湿沙世界里的事情真是越来越疯了。

lines.en: : You can say that again.
lines.zh: : 说得太对了。

lines.en: : Holy cannoli, Friendburger. Things are sure getting cray-cray over here in wet sand world.
lines.zh: : 我的天哪,朋友汉堡。湿沙世界里的事情真是越来越疯了。

lines.en: : You’re right about-
lines.zh: : 你说得对,关于——

lines.en: scene beachcookoff13
: Wait a minute, when did you two get here? And...{i}why{/i} are you here?
lines.zh: : 等一下,你们两个什么时候来的?还有……你们{i}为什么{/i}在这儿?

lines.en: : Today is the day of sun! The day of no creaming or sausage stuffing! The holes have been filled and the nuts are no more and all that is left is to enjoy being hot and wet!
lines.zh: : 今天是太阳之日!不奶油、不塞香肠的日子!洞已经被填满,坚果不复存在,剩下的只有享受又热又湿!

lines.en: : Was it necessary to bring Nao, though?
lines.zh: : 不过有必要把 Nao 也带来吗?

lines.en: scene beachcookoff14
: Nao-chan has never set leg-hand on baby glass before. And so a thought bubble happened and I decided to show her a world unseen! And look how not-sad she is in response to this!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱从来没有把腿手放到过小玻璃上。于是我脑海里冒出一个想法泡泡,决定带她去看一个前所未见的世界!看看她对此有多么不伤心!

lines.en: : I think she’s just excited about all of the food. And, not to ruin that for her or anything, but I doubt any of it will be edible.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她只是对这么多食物很兴奋。而且,我不是想扫她的兴什么的,但我怀疑这些东西没有一样能吃。

lines.en: : Anything is edible if your face hole can open wide enough and your insides are made of molten lava.
lines.zh: : 只要你的脸洞能张得够大、你的内脏是熔岩做的,任何东西都能吃。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if I understand that one, but you do you.
lines.zh: : 我不确定我听懂了,不过你高兴就好。

lines.en: scene beachcookoff15
: My angel...she’s come back to me...
lines.zh: : 我的天使……她回到我身边了……

lines.en: : Friendburger, help! A competitor in human trafficking has set its sights on Nao-chan and you must recover her before your share prices plummet!
lines.zh: : 朋友汉堡,救命!一个从事人口贩卖的竞争者盯上了 Nao 酱,你必须在你的股价暴跌之前把她找回来!

lines.en: : That’s just Chika. And if she does succeed in kidnapping Nao, I’m sure she’ll be easy to recover.
lines.zh: : 那只是 Chika。而且就算她真的成功绑架了 Nao,我相信把她找回来也不难。

lines.en: scene beachcookoff16
: Nao-chan! Do not gaze into her vision balls! She will consume the thoughts inside of you like the earth wolf consumes nesting termites!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱!别盯着她的眼球看!她会像土狼吞食筑巢白蚁一样,把你脑子里的念头吃光!

lines.en: : I knew you’d come back. I always believed.
lines.zh: : 我就知道你会回来。我一直都相信。

lines.en: scene sky
: Nao-chan, nooooooo!!!!!
The cooking competition officially begins with the ear-piercing screech of a whistle Uta removes from...somewhere. And the girls quickly begin pulling ingredients out of fully stocked refrigerators.
lines.zh: 厨艺比赛正式开始,伴随着 Uta 从……某个地方掏出的哨子发出的刺耳尖叫。女孩们迅速从塞得满满当当的冰箱里往外拿食材。

lines.en: No further instructions are given, so I’m not sure if they’re just free to make whatever they want but, either way, I can’t imagine either side will succeed when all is said and done.
lines.zh: 没有给出进一步的指示,所以我不确定她们是不是想做什么就做什么;但不管怎样,我想象不出等到一切结束时会有任何一方成功。

lines.en: Kaori and Nao watch attentively, one {i}significantly{/i} more attentively than the other...
lines.zh: Kaori 和 Nao 专注地看着,其中一个{i}明显{/i}比另一个专注得多……

lines.en: But I decide to focus elsewhere as Nodoka and a certain niece of mine seem to be locked in a rather serious looking conversation.
lines.zh: 但我决定把注意力放到别处,因为 Nodoka 和我某个侄女似乎正陷入一场看起来相当严肃的谈话。

lines.en: I can’t make out what it might be about from over here.
lines.zh: 从这边我听不清她们在说什么。

lines.en: I just know I don’t like the look of it.
lines.zh: 我只知道我不喜欢那副样子。

lines.en: scene beachcookoff17
: Okay, Sana! What are we making?!
lines.zh: : 好了,Sana!我们要做什么?!

lines.en: : Isn’t that...something you should know...before you pick up that...giant knife?...
lines.zh: : 那不是……你该在拿起那把……巨大的刀之前就知道的事吗?……

lines.en: : Probably! But I’ve wanted to hold one of these meat thingies since I saw Rena use one in Higurashi!
lines.zh: : 也许吧!但自从看到《寒蝉鸣泣之时》里 Rena 用这玩意儿,我就一直想握一把这种砍肉的东西!

lines.en: : Just grab a bunch of stuff and let me chop it up! Meat, preferably! Everybody likes meat!
lines.zh: : 随便抓一堆东西,让我来切!最好是肉!大家都喜欢肉!

lines.en: scene beachcookoff18
scene beachcookoff18
: Um...uhh...okay!
lines.zh: : 呃……呃呃……好的!

lines.en: : I am the bone of my meat thingy...Flesh is my body and blood is my blood...
lines.zh: : 吾为吾肉之骨……肉为吾之躯,血为吾之血……

lines.en: : I have created over a thousand microwavable dinners! Unknown to...non-microwavable dinners and...not known to...
lines.zh: : 吾曾创造过一千多份微波晚餐!不为人知的是……不可微波的晚餐,以及……不为人所……

lines.en: scene beachcookoff19
: Fuck! I can’t remember how it goes!
lines.zh: : 操!我想不起来后面怎么说了!

lines.en: : R...Rin! There are...so many different meats in here!
lines.zh: : R……Rin!这里面……有好多不同的肉!

lines.en: : Just grab all of them and we’ll figure it out later!
lines.zh: : 全都抓过来,我们之后再想办法!

lines.en: : Oh no! It looks like Team Rin hasn’t even figured out what they want to cook yet! But what about Team Molly?! How are they doing?!
lines.zh: : 哦不!看起来 Rin 队甚至还没决定要做什么菜!那 Molly 队呢?!她们进行得怎么样?!

lines.en: scene beachcookoff20
: Somehow even worse!
lines.zh: : 不知怎么的更糟!

lines.en: : You are not even using the correct tool. How do you expect to {i}create{/i} with an object made to destroy?
lines.zh: : 你连工具都用错了。你指望用一个用来破坏的东西来{i}创造{/i}?

lines.en: : Hell if I know, Kendo Princess! But I’m not about to go down without a fight, and a two-handed sword is far better to fight with than an iron dagger!
lines.zh: : 我他妈哪知道,剑道公主!不过我可不会不战而降,而且双手大剑比铁匕首更适合战斗!

lines.en: : The alternative is {i}not{/i} an iron dagger. It is a stainless steel kitchen knife. And what you are wielding now is a blade so dull it would not even be able to cut through salmon.
lines.zh: : 那{i}不是{/i}铁匕首。那是一把不锈钢厨刀。而你现在挥舞的那把刀钝得连三文鱼都切不动。

lines.en: scene beachcookoff21
: That’s it! Salmon! Retrieve me a salmon, great chef of the Sioux! For I will slay it and bring justice to my house!
lines.zh: : 有了!三文鱼!给我拿条三文鱼来,苏族的大厨!因为我要斩了它,为我的家族伸张正义!

lines.en: : And how do you intend to {i}prepare{/i} this salmon, Emerald Guardian?
lines.zh: : 那你打算怎么{i}烹制{/i}这条三文鱼,翡翠守护者?

lines.en: scene beachcookoff22
: All that matters is that it is prepared...{i}for death.{/i}
lines.zh: : 唯一重要的是,它已经准备好……{i}赴死了{/i}。

lines.en: : You are going to lose this competition if that is the best you can come up with.
lines.zh: : 如果这就是你能想出的最好答案,你会输掉这场比赛。

lines.en: : To die by the blade is to earn a spot in Valhalla. And if that is my fate, so be it.
lines.zh: : 死于刀下,就能在英灵殿占得一席之地。如果那是我的命运,那就这样吧。

lines.en: scene black
scene beachcookoff23
: Well, Imani- we’re twenty minutes into our competition now and neither side seems to have a clear goal in mind to come out on top. What are your thoughts on everything we’ve seen so far?
lines.zh: : 那么,Imani——比赛已经进行了二十分钟,双方似乎都没有一个明确的目标来取胜。你对目前看到的一切有什么看法?

lines.en: : That our class should be paying more attention in home economics!
lines.zh: : 我们班该在家政课上更认真一点!

lines.en: : I couldn’t agree more! Even a dummy like {i}me{/i} knows how to grill a fish.
lines.zh: : 我完全同意!连{i}我{/i}这样的傻子都知道怎么烤鱼。

lines.en: : But does a dummy like you know how to grill a {i}blobfish?{/i}
lines.zh: : 可是像你这样的傻子,知道怎么烤{i}水滴鱼{/i}吗?

lines.en: : Probably not! But why do you ask, Imani? What could that mean?
lines.zh: : 大概不知道!可你为什么这么问,Imani?这意味着什么?

lines.en: : I’ll tell you {i}exactly{/i} what it means, Uta!
lines.zh: : 我来告诉你这意味着什么,Uta!

lines.en: scene beachcookoff24
: It means it’s time for the mandatory cooking competition “twist!”
lines.zh: : 这意味着,是时候进入厨艺比赛例行的『反转』了!

lines.en: : A twist?! Twenty minutes into the competition?! But what does that mean for all of the careful preparation and planning that has gone into both dishes thus far?!
lines.zh: : 反转?!比赛才进行二十分钟?!那对两道菜到目前为止所做的精心准备和规划意味着什么?!

lines.en: : Absolutely nothing! Because Team Rin’s grill is packed with overseasoned meat and Team Molly’s grill is packed with...nothing! There is nothing on Team Molly’s grill.
lines.zh: : 什么也不意味着!因为 Rin 队的烤架上塞满了调味过度的肉,而 Molly 队的烤架上塞满了……什么都没有!Molly 队的烤架上什么都没有。

lines.en: : What, Sana? I’m in the zone.
lines.zh: : 怎么了,Sana?我正进入状态呢。

lines.en: : Somebody just...handed me something...and...and I think...you’re supposed to cook it?...
lines.zh: : 有人刚刚……递给我一个东西……而且……而且我觉得……你是要把它做熟的?……

lines.en: : Well, hurry up and bring it over then! I’ll clear up some room for it!
lines.zh: : 那就赶紧拿过来!我给它腾点地方!

lines.en: scene beachcookoff25
: Rin, I think it’s still alive. I can feel it breathing and it’s all slippery.
lines.zh: : Rin,我觉得它还活着。我能感觉到它在呼吸,而且浑身滑溜溜的。

lines.en: : Just put it on the fucking grill, Sana! I don’t have time for this!
lines.zh: : 把它他妈的放到烤架上就好,Sana!我没时间搞这个!

lines.en: scene beachcookoff26
: Yes, chef!
lines.zh: : 是,主厨!

lines.en: : Ew! What the fuck is that thing?! It’s got a face!
lines.zh: : 呕!那到底是什么鬼东西?!它有张脸!

lines.en: : I don’t know but I don’t like it!
lines.zh: : 我不知道,可我不喜欢它!

lines.en: : Me neither! Get it off the grill!
lines.zh: : 我也是!把它从烤架上弄下来!

lines.en: : Don’t make me touch it again, chef!
lines.zh: : 别让我再碰它了,主厨!

lines.en: : Damn it, Sana! You’ll do what I tell you and you’ll like it!
lines.zh: : 该死,Sana!我让你干什么你就干什么,而且你得喜欢!

lines.en: : No I won’t, chef!
lines.zh: : 我不会喜欢的,主厨!

lines.en: scene beachcookoff27
: Get your head in the game, soldier! Do you want to sleep at Sensei’s house or not?!
lines.zh: : 专心点,士兵!你想不想睡在 Sensei 家?!

lines.en: : I have no idea, chef!
lines.zh: : 我不知道,主厨!

lines.en: : Well, I kind of do! And if you ever want to borrow another FPS, you better grab that weird face fish and throw it back into the ocean! Now!
lines.zh: : 嗯,我倒有点想!而且要是你还想再借 FPS 游戏,最好抓起那条怪脸鱼,把它扔回海里!现在!

lines.en: : Yes, chef!
lines.zh: : 是,主厨!

lines.en: scene beachcookoff28
: Kendo Princess, I believe we may just lose this competition.
lines.zh: : 剑道公主,我觉得我们可能会输掉这场比赛。

lines.en: : I believe that is essentially inevitable at this point due to your indecision and desire to simply wave around a katana instead of cooking.
lines.zh: : 我认为在这一点上,这基本上已经无法避免了,因为你优柔寡断,只想挥舞武士刀,而不是做饭。

lines.en: : In regard to the secret ingredient you were provided, what would be your suggested method of cooking it?
lines.zh: : 关于发给你们的秘密食材,你建议用什么方法来烹饪它?

lines.en: : I am not sure as I have never seen such a creature before. But I have decided to close its eyes as it seems intelligent and I do not believe it should be aware that death is on the horizon.
lines.zh: : 我不确定,因为我从没见过这种生物。不过我决定把它的眼睛合上,因为它看起来有智慧,而我不认为它该意识到死亡就在眼前。

lines.en: : Is it anything like a salmon?
lines.zh: : 它和三文鱼之类的东西像吗?

lines.en: : Is that truly something you should be asking after refusing to cook the {i}last{/i} salmon I brought you?
lines.zh: : 在你拒绝烹饪我{i}上一条{/i}拿给你的三文鱼之后,你真的该问这个吗?

lines.en: : I made eye contact with it. I couldn’t follow through, Kendo Princess.
lines.zh: : 我和它对视了。我下不了手,剑道公主。

lines.en: scene beachcookoff29
: It was already {i}filleted.{/i} There were no eyes to make contact with.
lines.zh: : 它已经{i}切好鱼片{/i}了。根本没有眼睛可以对视。

lines.en: : Damn these advanced druidic powers and my ability to communicate with animals long after they have perished!
lines.zh: : 该死的,这高级德鲁伊之力,还有我在动物死后很久仍能与之交流的能力!

lines.en: scene beachcookoff30
: Guardian, vanquish this fish immediately. As your master, I command you.
lines.zh: : 守护者,立刻消灭这条鱼。作为你的主人,我命令你。

lines.en: : Will you use a command seal?
lines.zh: : 你会用令咒吗?

lines.en: : I do not know what that is. I just know that this ingredient must be used and that we are running out of time. Do not look into its eyes. Nor the ones in its heart.
lines.zh: : 我不知道那是什么。我只知道这个食材必须用上,而且我们时间不多了。别看它的眼睛。也别看它心里那双眼睛。

lines.en: : I’m not even sure this is a fish. It looks more like a slime.
lines.zh: : 我甚至不确定这是不是鱼。它看起来更像一只史莱姆。

lines.en: scene beachcookoff31
: Unfortunately for {i}it,{/i} slimes are the lowest level creature in many JRPGs...and one that I am all too familiar with slaying.
lines.zh: : 对{i}它{/i}来说不幸的是,史莱姆是很多日式 RPG 里最低级的生物……而我对斩杀它们再熟悉不过了。

lines.en: : This is the perfect chance to begin my journey...and begin it shall.
lines.zh: : 这是开启我旅程的绝佳机会……而旅程就要开始了。

lines.en: : I am the bone of my sword...Steel is my body and-
lines.zh: : 吾为吾剑之骨,钢为吾之躯,而——

lines.en: : I already used that monologue! Get your own!
lines.zh: : 那段独白我已经用过了!自己想一个!

lines.en: scene beachcookoff32
: Damn it, Nithhala! You don’t even have a sword!
lines.zh: : 该死,Nithhala!你连剑都没有!

lines.en: : Why do {i}you{/i} have a sword?! Where did you even get it?!
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}为什么会有剑?!你从哪儿弄来的?!

lines.en: : It was in the fridge!
lines.zh: : 它在冰箱里!

lines.en: : Why?!
lines.zh: : 为什么?!

lines.en: : I don’t know! It just was!
lines.zh: : 我不知道!它就在那儿!

lines.en: : Guardian, time is running-
lines.zh: : 守护者,时间不够——

lines.en: scene sky
: Die, slime!
lines.zh: : 去死吧,史莱姆!

lines.en: Molly brings her sword down and...
lines.zh: Molly 挥剑砍下,然后……

lines.en: And completely misses.
lines.zh: 然后完全没砍中。

lines.en: She swings it again and...
lines.zh: 她又挥了一次,然后……

lines.en: Well, she makes contact this time. But the blade is so dull that it sort of just bounces off of the weird creature and comes back at her.
lines.zh: 嗯,这次确实砍中了。可刀刃太钝,它基本就是从那只怪东西身上弹开,又朝她弹了回来。

lines.en: But, after ten minutes of repeatedly swinging, the fish {i}is{/i} reduced to pieces, just...none of them look particularly edible and I’m pretty sure that the “special ingredient” is the “only” ingredient in her dish.
lines.zh: 不过,在反复挥砍十分钟后,那条鱼{i}被剁成{/i}了碎块,只是……没有一块看起来特别能吃,而且我敢肯定,这个『特别食材』就是她这道菜的『唯一』食材。

lines.en: scene beachcookoff33
: Well, Sensei! Now that both teams are finished cooking, and I use the word “cooking” very lightly here, are you excited to dig in and judge the dishes?!
lines.zh: : 那么,Sensei!既然两队都做好了——我用『做』这个字是用得很宽松的,你有没有很兴奋地想要开动并评判这两道菜?!

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : In fact, I've decided I'm just {i}not{/i} going to do that.
lines.zh: : 事实上,我决定我{i}不{/i}打算干这件事。

lines.en: : But...But someone needs to judge them! You can’t grade food on just the presentation alone!
lines.zh: : 可……可总得有人来评判!你不能只看卖相就给食物打分!

lines.en: : You do it then.
lines.zh: : 那你自己来。

lines.en: : I had a big breakfast. I’m not hungry.
lines.zh: : 我早餐吃得很饱。我不饿。

lines.en: : Same here. Looks like everyone loses.
lines.zh: : 我也是。看来所有人都输了。

lines.en: : But...but {i}somebody{/i} has to-
lines.zh: : 可……可总得{i}有人{/i}——

lines.en: scene beachcookoff34
: Nao-chan?! Are you sure?! Neither of the foods that were fooded are foods that you’ve unfooded yourself before! It could be dangerous!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱?!你确定?!这两份被做成食物的食物,都不是你以前把食物变成非食物的东西!可能会有危险!

lines.en: scene beachcookoff35
: I understand.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: scene beachcookoff36
: Small girl with large chestular flesh-pouches!
lines.zh: : 胸部肉袋很大的小姑娘!

lines.en: : Yes?!
: Nao-chan will unfood the foods!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱要把这些食物变成非食物!

lines.en: : Are you sure about this, Kaori? It’s very possible that she’ll die. In fact, I’d probably wager at this point that it’s {i}likely{/i} she will die.
lines.zh: : 你确定吗,Kaori?她很有可能会死。事实上,到这一步我大概会打赌她{i}很可能{/i}会死。

lines.en: : Nao-chan has made the decision herself, Friend. And she deserves freedom as much as the rest of us do.
lines.zh: : Nao 酱是自己做的决定,朋友。而她和我们其他人一样,配得上自由。

lines.en: : That is great news! But please be advised that we should not be held responsible for any injuries or fatalities that take place as a result of the consumption of the “food” made here today.
lines.zh: : 这是个好消息!但请注意:对于因食用今天在这里『做』出的『食物』而造成的任何伤害或死亡,我们不承担任何责任。

lines.en: scene sky
All of us who have been forced to pay attention to the cooking contest watch carefully as Nao approaches both dishes.
lines.zh: 所有被迫观看这场厨艺比赛的人,都紧紧盯着走向两道菜的 Nao。

lines.en: And while neither of them look particularly alluring, Rin’s does look at least {i}edible.{/i} The one made by Molly is essentially just a hastily chopped-up looking version of the “fish” she was asked to cook.
lines.zh: 虽然两道菜看起来都不怎么誘人,但 Rin 的那道至少看起来{i}还能吃{/i}。Molly 做的那道,基本上只是把她被要求烹饪的那条『鱼』草草剁碎的版本。

lines.en: In spite of that, though...Nao lifts it up and takes a small bite out of what I am pretty confident used to be its head.
lines.zh: 尽管如此……Nao 把它举起来,咬了一小口那东西——我相当确定那是它的头。

lines.en: But, after chewing it for an uncomfortable amount of time, she spits it right back out onto the plate before marching over to Rin’s dish and likely attempting to forget whatever it was she just put in her mouth.
lines.zh: 但在嚼了一段令人不适的时间之后,她直接把它吐回盘子里,然后大步走向 Rin 的那道菜,大概是想忘掉刚才放进嘴里的东西。

lines.en: Nao {i}does{/i} seem to like Rin’s food more, as she’s actually able to swallow it — the only thing is that I’m not sure if she’ll be disqualified for omitting the mystery ingredient.
lines.zh: Nao {i}似乎{/i}更喜欢 Rin 的食物,因为她真的咽下去了——唯一的问题是,我不确定她会不会因为没有用到神秘食材而被判出局。

lines.en: scene beachcookoff37
: Follow your heart, Nao. Search deep within yourself and think about what makes cooking important to {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 跟着你的心走,Nao。深入自己的内心,想想烹饪对{i}你{/i}来说为什么重要。

lines.en: : And even if your answer goes against what my partner managed to create, know that I will not-
lines.zh: : 就算你的答案与我搭档做出来的东西相悖,也要知道,我不会——

lines.en: scene beachcookoff38
: Yeah, that’s fair.
lines.zh: : 好吧,这很公道。

lines.en: : Heck yeah! Thank you, strange girl who showed up out of nowhere! I knew I could count on you! Just not really because you’re a strange girl who showed up out of nowhere!
lines.zh: : 太好了!谢谢你,不知从哪儿冒出来的怪女孩!我就知道能指望你!虽然其实不能,因为你就是个不知从哪儿冒出来的怪女孩!

lines.en: : No fair! Rin didn’t even use the secret ingredient! I became a murderer for the sake of my dish! The weight of death weighs heavily upon my conscience!
lines.zh: : 不公平!Rin 根本没用秘密食材!我为了这道菜成了杀人犯!死亡的重量重重压在我的良心上!

lines.en: : A true chef would not care at all about such a thing.
lines.zh: : 真正的厨子根本不会在意这种事。

lines.en: : On the topic of the mystery ingredient, the correct move was actually {i}not{/i} using it!
lines.zh: : 关于那个神秘食材,正确的做法其实就是{i}不用{/i}它!

lines.en: scene beachcookoff39
: What?!
lines.zh: : 什么?!

lines.en: : You heard that right, Molly! Cooking shows {i}always{/i} have some kind of twist ingredient chefs need to incorporate in order to win, but {i}our{/i} twist was having an ingredient you’re {i}not{/i} supposed to use!
lines.zh: : 你没听错,Molly!烹饪节目{i}总{/i}会有某种反转食材,厨师必须把它加进去才能赢,可{i}我们的{/i}反转是给你一样{i}不该{/i}用的食材!

lines.en: : A real chef would know that the blobfish is basically inedible! Rin having Sana throw hers away was the only smart move either team made all day!
lines.zh: : 真正的大厨会知道水滴鱼基本不能吃!Rin 让 Sana 把它扔掉,是两队今天一整天做过的唯一明智之举!

lines.en: : This is an injustice! I demand a reroll!
lines.zh: : 这是不公!我要求重骰!

lines.en: : Accept the loss, Emerald Guardian. I too have failed you in not properly identifying an inedible ingredient.
lines.zh: : 接受失败吧,翡翠守护者。我也没能正确辨认出不能食用的食材,是我辜负了你。

lines.en: : This can not be how my undefeated streak comes to an end! I will not stand for it!
lines.zh: : 我的不败纪录绝不能就这么终结!我绝不接受!

lines.en: scene beachcookoff40
: How’s it feel to lose to someone with zero wins, Molly? Gonna report me for cheating?
lines.zh: : 输给一个零胜场的人感觉如何,Molly?打算举报我作弊?

lines.en: : I don’t have to, Nithhala. Everyone here knows you cheated by not following the rules of the contest! {i}Plus{/i} my KDR was higher than yours and we all know that’s what really matters.
lines.zh: : 用不着,Nithhala。这里的每个人都知道你不遵守比赛规则、靠作弊赢的!{i}再说{/i}我的 KDR 比你高,而我们都知道那才是真正重要的。

lines.en: : Sorry, can you say that again? I’m having trouble hearing you from all the way up here in the winners’ bracket.
lines.zh: : 抱歉,你能再说一遍吗?我在胜者组这么高的地方,听不太清。

lines.en: $ beachwarfloor1points += 1
scene black
: You will rue the day you crossed Molly MacCormack! This is not the end! It is not- ack!
lines.zh: : 你会后悔招惹 Molly MacCormack 这一天的!这还没完!这绝不是——啊!

lines.en: : You will be coming with me now, Guardian. I will no longer allow you to ignore my instructions and will turn you into the greatest chef to have ever lived.
lines.zh: : 你现在得跟我走,守护者。我不会再允许你无视我的指示了,我要把你变成有史以来最伟大的厨师。

lines.en: : But I’m tired of working! I want to play games!
lines.zh: : 可我受够了工作!我想玩游戏!

lines.en: A team of who I can only imagine are workers hired by Touka show up to break down all of the equipment and-
lines.zh: 一队我只能想象是 Touka 雇来的工人赶来拆走所有设备,然后——

lines.en: : Umm...Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……Sensei?……

lines.en: And a soft tug on my sleeve pulls me away from one competition I {i}don’t{/i} care about toward one that I {i}do.{/i}
lines.zh: 而袖子上轻轻的一拉,把我从一场我{i}不在乎{/i}的比赛,带向了一场我{i}在乎{/i}的。

lines.en: $ beachwars13 = True
jump beachwars14
